hint_ladder: Ask someone to remember a fact and act on it.
Use keep before in mind; what must be remembered comes after the phrase or before it as a pronoun.
Start with the words: Keep it ___ mind that the office closes at six.
teaching_content.reveal_form: Keep in mind that the office closes at six.
canonical_forms: Keep in mind that the office closes at six.
alternative_realizations: Bear in mind that the office closes at six.
